articles.summary: SILVER SPRING, Md., May 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Urban One has entered into an agreement to acquire Service Broadcasting Group, LLC, including its flagship radio stations KKDA and KRNB. Urban One has also agreed to sell radio station KZMJ to Fuzion Dallas, LLC.
articles.title: Urban One Announces Agreements to Acquire Dallas Radio Stations KKDA and KRNB and to Sell KZMJ
